strains.name: Pineapples in Space #4
strains.type_reason: Pineapple Tart (indica-dom) x Space Runtz (hybrid) — indica structure and density dominate; uplifting candy-fruit energy from Runtz keeps it short of pure indica.
strains.notes: Pineapple Tart x Space Runtz. #4 pheno selected by Smashby's Trees in Trinidad, CO. Dense candied pineapple trichomes, easy to root. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Rainbow Runtz
strains.type_reason: Zkittlez (indica-hybrid) x White Runtz (Zkittlez x Gelato) — balanced hybrid parents produce equal sativa euphoria and indica body; neither side dominates.
strains.notes: Zkittlez x White Runtz. Producer: Runtz Crew x Laughing Gas collab. Cup-winning candy variety. Dense purple buds. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Jam Pack #2
strains.type_reason: PTG original selected for heavy resin and body-stone — effect profile is indica-dominant (creeping, sedating) but hybrid genetic base prevents full indica classification.
strains.notes: PTG original breed. ~7% to rosin — hasher's dream selection from their pheno hunt.

strains.name: Kryptochronic
strains.type_reason: FPOG (sativa-hybrid) x Alien Cookies (indica-hybrid) x Jet Fuel Gelato (hybrid) — sativa cerebral onset and indica body depth are genuinely balanced across three complex hybrid parents.
strains.notes: (Fruity Pebbles OG x Alien Cookies) x Jet Fuel Gelato. Bred by Compound Genetics, cultivated and distributed by Alien Labs.

strains.name: Cherry Jealousy
strains.type_reason: Cherry x Jealousy (Sherbet Bx1 x Gelato 41) — Jealousy is a true balanced hybrid; cherry parent adds fruit-forward brightness that holds the sativa side up equally.
strains.notes: PTG original breed. Cherry cross on Jealousy (Sherbet Bx1 x Gelato 41 by Seed Junky). Deep cherry-gas profile.

strains.name: Lipsmackerz
strains.type_reason: LCG (sativa-hybrid) x Z Animal Cookies (indica-dominant) x Good Greens Candy (indica-leaning) — Z Animal and Candy genetics pull the balance indica; PTG notes it as 'Good Smoke' not a daytime strain.
strains.notes: (LCG x Z Animal) x Good Greens Candy. CLTVTD x Good Greens collab. Purple-expressing, Sweet flavor. Good Smoke (not listed as hasher by PTG). Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Limecicle
strains.type_reason: Zkittlez x Strawberry Zkillato — Zkittlez-family genetics carry indica structure but the limonene-dominant terpene profile drives a bright, uplifting, citrus-energetic effect that skews sativa in experience.
strains.notes: Zkittlez x Strawberry Zkillato. Zesty lime-citrus terpene profile. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Papayamosa
strains.type_reason: LCG (sativa-leaning hybrid) x Blueberry Mimosa (sativa-dominant hybrid) — both parents lean sativa; daytime-friendly, uplifting, functional effect with indica structure underneath.
strains.notes: LCG x Blueberry Mimosa. 6%+ to rosin. Tropical citrus-papaya terpene profile. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Nana Glue
strains.type_reason: GG4 (indica-dominant) x Banana Butter Cups (Banana Punch x PB & Jealous, both indica-dom) — stacked indica genetics; Monroe's Bedhead pheno selected specifically for heavy couchlock body stone.
strains.notes: Gorilla Glue #4 x Banana Butter Cups. Monroe's Bedhead cut — verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens. Indica-dominant. Heavy resin, banana-diesel terpenes.

strains.name: Cream Smoothie
strains.type_reason: Gelonade (Gelato 41 x Lemon Tree, sativa-leaning) x C.R.E.A.M. (hybrid) — Gelonade's sativa brightness and citrus-energy character dominates; PTG notes ~8-9 week finish typical of sativa-hybrid timing.
strains.notes: Gelonade x C.R.E.A.M. Dessert hybrid with citrus-cream terpene axis. ~8-9 week finish. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Grease Monkey
strains.type_reason: Cookies & Cream (indica-heavy GSC cross) x GG4 (indica-dominant) — two of the heaviest indica-leaning genetics in the cookie family stack into a deeply sedating, body-dominant experience.
strains.notes: Cookies & Cream x Gorilla Glue #4. Dense resinous indica-dominant with diesel-cookie profile.

strains.name: Blue Nerdz
strains.type_reason: Blue Sherb (Blue Cookies x Sunset Sherbet, indica-hybrid) x Zkittlez (indica-hybrid) — both parents are indica-hybrids; Zkittlez brightens the effect but the indica structure and body-weight lean dominant.
strains.notes: Blue Sherb [Blue Cookies x Sunset Sherb] x Zkittlez. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Jet Fuel OG
strains.type_reason: Aspen OG (sativa-dominant) x High Country Diesel (sativa-dominant) — both parents are sativa-dom; diesel-fuel terpene stack drives energetic, cerebral, uplifting experience with minimal body sedation.
strains.notes: Aspen OG x High Country Diesel. Bred by 303 Seeds. B-Real (Cypress Hill / Dr. Greenthumb) has championed this cut and branded it under his name — a strain he's worked with since the early era. Sativa-dominant, high-octane diesel fuel terps.

strains.name: Blue Dream
strains.type_reason: DJ Short's Blueberry (indica) x Santa Cruz Haze (sativa) — Haze dominates expression in this cut; tall structure, long flower time, and cerebral-energetic effects are pure sativa characteristics.
strains.notes: DJ Short's Blueberry x Santa Cruz Haze. Classic SoCal heirloom, made famous around 2003. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Pre 98 Bubba Kush
strains.type_reason: Pure indica heirloom descended from Hindu Kush landrace — compact hash-plant structure, short flower time, heavy sedating body stone, and near-zero sativa characteristics define this as a true indica.
strains.notes: Classic SoCal indica heirloom, pre-1998 phenotype. Exact lineage unknown. Hash plant structure, heavy sedating indica. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Skywalker OG
strains.type_reason: True OG Kush (Emerald Triangle x Nevil's Hindu Kush) — OG Kush is indica-dominant by lineage; Hollywood cut expresses deep body relaxation, heavy sedation, and the classic lemon-fuel OG indica profile.
strains.notes: TRUE OG Kush clone (Emerald Triangle x Nevil's Hindu Kush). Renamed 'Skywalker OG' at the Sunset Collective in West Hollywood. PTG received it from a mentor who held it 15+ years. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Kush Mintz
strains.type_reason: Bubba Kush (pure indica) x Animal Mints (Animal Cookies x SinMint Cookies, indica-dominant) — stacked indica genetics with Rabid Hippie pheno selected for the heaviest body stone and densest structure.
strains.notes: Bubba Kush x Animal Mints. Rabid Hippie cut — SoCal classic. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.

strains.name: Permanent Marker
strains.type_reason: Biscotti (GSC x Gelato, hybrid) x Jealousy (Sherbet Bx1 x Gelato 41, hybrid) x Sherb Bx (hybrid) — three hybrid parents with heavy indica-leaning effect; PTG and Doja Exclusive describe it as a 'heavy stone' that skews indica.
strains.notes: Biscotti x Jealousy x Sherb Bx1. Bred by Seed Junky Genetics. Pungent permanent marker / gas terpene profile. Verified cut from Pig Tail Gardens.
